./SparkR_prep-0.1.sh <http://SparkR_prep-0.1.sh>

sudo USE_YARN=1 SPARK_VERSION=1.3.0 SPARK_HADOOP_VERSION=2.6.0-cdh5.4.5 SPARK_YARN_VERSION=2.6.0 ./install-dev.sh
